species.name: Treecko
species.flavor: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

species.name: Grovyle
species.flavor: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

species.name: Sceptile
species.flavor: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.

species.name: Torchic
species.flavor: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

species.name: Combusken
species.flavor: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

species.name: Blaziken
species.flavor: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

species.name: Mudkip
species.flavor: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.

species.name: Marshtomp
species.flavor: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.

species.name: Swampert
species.flavor: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

species.name: Poochyena
species.flavor: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

species.name: Mightyena
species.flavor: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

species.name: Zigzagoon
species.flavor: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigs and zags.

species.name: Linoone
species.flavor: When running in a straight line, it can top 60 miles per hour. However, it has a tough time with curved roads.

species.name: Wurmple
species.flavor: It lives amidst tall grass and in forests. When attacked, it resists by pointing its venomous spikes at the foe.

species.name: Silcoon
species.flavor: It conserves its energy by moving as little as possible. It awaits evolution while drinking only a little rainwater.

species.name: Beautifly
species.flavor: Despite its appearance, it has an aggressive nature. It attacks by jabbing with its long, thin mouth.

species.name: Cascoon
species.flavor: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.

species.name: Dustox
species.flavor: It scatters horribly toxic dust when it senses danger. They tend to gather in the glow of streetlamps at night.

species.name: Lotad
species.flavor: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.

species.name: Lombre
species.flavor: It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.

species.name: Ludicolo
species.flavor: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates LUDICOLO’s cells, making it more powerful.

species.name: Seedot
species.flavor: If it remains still, it becomes impossible to distinguish from real nuts. It delights in surprising foraging PIDGEY.

species.name: Nuzleaf
species.flavor: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of NUZLEAF’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.

species.name: Shiftry
species.flavor: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe’s mind and take preemptive action.

species.name: Taillow
species.flavor: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

species.name: Swellow
species.flavor: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

species.name: Wingull
species.flavor: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

species.name: Pelipper
species.flavor: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

species.name: Ralts
species.flavor: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

species.name: Kirlia
species.flavor: The cheerful spirit of its TRAINER gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

species.name: Gardevoir
species.flavor: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its TRAINER.

species.name: Surskit
species.flavor: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

species.name: Masquerain
species.flavor: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

species.name: Shroomish
species.flavor: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

species.name: Breloom
species.flavor: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.

species.name: Slakoth
species.flavor: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

species.name: Vigoroth
species.flavor: It is always hungry because it won’t stop rampaging. Even while it is eating, it can’t keep still.

species.name: Slaking
species.flavor: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

species.name: Nincada
species.flavor: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

species.name: Ninjask
species.flavor: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

species.name: Shedinja
species.flavor: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a POKé BALL when a NINCADA evolves.

species.name: Whismur
species.flavor: It usually murmurs, but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

species.name: Loudred
species.flavor: When it stamps its feet and bellows, it generates ultrasonic waves that can blow apart a house.

species.name: Exploud
species.flavor: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

species.name: Makuhita
species.flavor: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

species.name: Hariyama
species.flavor: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

species.name: Azurill
species.flavor: It battles by flinging around its tail, which is bigger than its body. The tail is a flotation device in water.

species.name: Nosepass
species.flavor: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check NOSEPASS to get their bearings.

species.name: Skitty
species.flavor: It is said to be difficult to earn its trust. However, it is extremely popular for its cute looks and behavior.

species.name: Delcatty
species.flavor: The favorite of trend-conscious female TRAINERS, they are used in competition for their style and fur.

species.name: Sableye
species.flavor: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

species.name: Mawile
species.flavor: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

species.name: Aron
species.flavor: It eats iron to build its steel body. It is a pest that descends from mountains to eat bridges and train tracks.

species.name: Lairon
species.flavor: It habitually shows off its strength with the size of sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

species.name: Aggron
species.flavor: It claims a large mountain as its sole territory. It mercilessly thrashes those that violate its space.

species.name: Meditite
species.flavor: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

species.name: Medicham
species.flavor: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance- like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.

species.name: Electrike
species.flavor: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

species.name: Manectric
species.flavor: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

species.name: Plusle
species.flavor: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

species.name: Minun
species.flavor: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

species.name: Volbeat
species.flavor: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

species.name: Illumise
species.flavor: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.

species.name: Roselia
species.flavor: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the ROSELIA is.

species.name: Gulpin
species.flavor: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

species.name: Swalot
species.flavor: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

species.name: Carvanha
species.flavor: It lives in massive rivers that course through jungles. It swarms prey that enter its territory.

species.name: Sharpedo
species.flavor: The ruffian of the seas, it has fangs that crunch through iron. It swims by jetting water from its rear.

species.name: Wailmer
species.flavor: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

species.name: Wailord
species.flavor: It is among the largest of all Pokémon. It herds prey in a pack then swallows the massed prey in one gulp.

species.name: Numel
species.flavor: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

species.name: Camerupt
species.flavor: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

species.name: Torkoal
species.flavor: It burns coal inside its shell. If it is attacked, it belches thick, black smoke and flees.

species.name: Spoink
species.flavor: It apparently dies if it stops bouncing about. It carries a pearl from CLAMPERL on its head.

species.name: Grumpig
species.flavor: It can gain control over foes by doing odd dance steps. The black pearls on its forehead are precious gems.

species.name: Spinda
species.flavor: No two SPINDA are said to have identical patterns. It confuses foes with its stumbling motions.

species.name: Trapinch
species.flavor: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

species.name: Vibrava
species.flavor: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

species.name: Flygon
species.flavor: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

species.name: Cacnea
species.flavor: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

species.name: Cacturne
species.flavor: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.

species.name: Swablu
species.flavor: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

species.name: Altaria
species.flavor: If you hear a beautiful melody trilling deep among mountains far from people, it is ALTARIA’s humming.

species.name: Zangoose
species.flavor: If it comes across a SEVIPER, its fur bristles and it assumes its battle pose. Its sharp claws are its best weapon.

species.name: Seviper
species.flavor: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

species.name: Lunatone
species.flavor: Its health ebbs and flows with the lunar cycle. It brims with power when exposed to the light of the full moon.

species.name: Solrock
species.flavor: It absorbs solar energy during the day. Always expressionless, it can sense what its foe is thinking.

species.name: Barboach
species.flavor: It probes muddy riverbeds with its two long whiskers. A slimy film protects its body.

species.name: Whiscash
species.flavor: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything - if it is alive, WHISCASH will eat it.

species.name: Corphish
species.flavor: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

species.name: Crawdaunt
species.flavor: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.

species.name: Baltoy
species.flavor: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

species.name: Claydol
species.flavor: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

species.name: Lileep
species.flavor: It became extinct roughly 100 million years ago. It was regenerated from a fossil using advanced techniques.

species.name: Cradily
species.flavor: It ensnares prey with its eight tentacles. It then melts the prey with a strong acid before feeding.

species.name: Anorith
species.flavor: It is a kind of Pokémon progenitor. It uses its extending claws to catch prey hiding among rocks on the seafloor.

species.name: Armaldo
species.flavor: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

species.name: Feebas
species.flavor: Ridiculed for its shabby appearance, it is ignored by researchers. It lives in ponds choked with weeds.

species.name: Milotic
species.flavor: MILOTIC is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

species.name: Castform
species.flavor: It has the ability to change its form into the sun, the rain, or a snow cloud, depending on the weather.

species.name: Kecleon
species.flavor: It changes body color to blend in with its surroundings. It also changes color if it is happy or sad.

species.name: Shuppet
species.flavor: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

species.name: Banette
species.flavor: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokémon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.

species.name: Duskull
species.flavor: Making itself invisible, it silently sneaks up to prey. It has the ability to slip through thick walls.

species.name: Dusclops
species.flavor: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

species.name: Tropius
species.flavor: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

species.name: Chimecho
species.flavor: It travels by riding on winds. It cleverly uses its long tail to pluck nuts and berries, which it loves to eat.

species.name: Absol
species.flavor: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

species.name: Wynaut
species.flavor: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

species.name: Snorunt
species.flavor: It is said that a home visited by a SNORUNT will prosper. It can withstand cold of minus 150 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Glalie
species.flavor: It has a body of ice that won’t melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

species.name: Spheal
species.flavor: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

species.name: Sealeo
species.flavor: It touches new things with its nose to test for smell and feel. It plays by spinning SPHEAL on its nose.

species.name: Walrein
species.flavor: It swims through icy seas while shattering ice floes with its large tusks. It is protected by its thick blubber.

species.name: Clamperl
species.flavor: It is protected by a sturdy shell. Once in a lifetime, it makes a magnificent pearl.

species.name: Huntail
species.flavor: It lives deep in the sea where no light ever filters down. It lights up its small fishlike tail to attract prey.

species.name: Gorebyss
species.flavor: Its swimming form is exquisitely elegant. With its thin mouth, it feeds on seaweed that grows between rocks.

species.name: Relicanth
species.flavor: It has remained unchanged for 100 million years. It was discovered during a deep-sea exploration.

species.name: Luvdisc
species.flavor: During the spawning season, countless LUVDISC congregate at coral reefs, turning the waters pink.

species.name: Bagon
species.flavor: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

species.name: Shelgon
species.flavor: Its armored body makes all attacks bounce off. The armor is too tough, however, making it heavy and somewhat sluggish.

species.name: Salamence
species.flavor: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.

species.name: Beldum
species.flavor: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.

species.name: Metang
species.flavor: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.

species.name: Metagross
species.flavor: It is formed by two METANG fusing. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

species.name: Regirock
species.flavor: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.

species.name: Regice
species.flavor: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.

species.name: Registeel
species.flavor: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.

species.name: Latias
species.flavor: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

species.name: Latios
species.flavor: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.

species.name: Kyogre
species.flavor: This Pokémon is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

species.name: Groudon
species.flavor: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.

species.name: Rayquaza
species.flavor: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.

species.name: Jirachi
species.flavor: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.

species.name: Deoxys
species.flavor: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.
